patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often centered or in a two-column layout, prominently featuring large, detailed UI mockups.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings for primary messages, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text for readability.
A clean, high-contrast palette dominated by white, a vibrant blue, and dark gray, with subtle pink/red accents primarily within UI elements.
Sections are introduced with a subtle, staggered fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a gentle reveal effect.
Major content blocks are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, vibrant blue, and dark gray).

technique_notes: Sections are animated into view using scroll-triggered css-keyframes that apply a slight upward translation and opacity change, making content appear to gently slide up and fade in as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section features a prominent, interactive-looking UI mockup that serves as a central visual element, likely a Lottie animation or complex SVG/CSS animation to showcase product functionality.
Call-to-action buttons consistently use a primary solid blue fill and a secondary outlined style, maintaining uniform sizing and a subtle corner radius.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approximately 3-4x body size) are paired with a clean, readable body text for clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, cards, and UI elements, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, becoming more compact in feature grids and FAQs.

standout: The site stands out with its highly detailed and visually engaging UI mockups, which are central to each section and effectively demonstrate the product's functionality. The consistent use of a vibrant, energetic blue against clean white and dark backgrounds creates a modern and trustworthy feel, making complex software appear approachable.
